configuration.format.keywordCase.descrip: Letter case of SQL keywords (`SELECT`, `FROM`, …) when formatting.

configuration.format.indentStyle.descrip: How clauses are indented when formatting SQL.
configuration.format.indentStyle.standar: Each clause on its own line, its contents indented below it.
configuration.format.indentStyle.tabular: Keywords in a column on the left, contents after them.
